Rosa Fontaine
rosa.fontaine@example.com | San Francisco, CA
Rosa Fontaine has 7 years of experience in mobile. Most recently, Senior Mobile
Engineer at Nimbus Cloud (2023-2026), where they wrote a lightweight Node.js
BFF layer to aggregate REST calls for the mobile app. Before that, Mobile
Engineer at Crestline Digital (2019-2023). Education: B.S. Software
Engineering, NC State University, 2019. Core skills: Distributed systems,
Node.js, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Swift, GraphQL.
